$description: The notices of the MobilityData GTFS validator, as utils/validatorNotices.json lists them for the pinned release (scripts/validator-notices.js writes that list from the JAR), each with the section the product files it under and its description in English. The French descriptions are in locales/fr.json, the titles in ruleTitles.json. Keyed by the snake_case code a validation report carries; default_severity is the validator's own. mobilitydataAlignment.test.js holds all of it to the list.

$severity_legend.error: What the GTFS specification requires or forbids outright. A network opens with its errors; a delivery refuses an error the feed did not carry when it was loaded (G1).
$severity_legend.warning: What the specification recommends, or what harms the quality of the data. Reported, never refused.
$severity_legend.info: What does not harm the data: a file or a column the specification does not know, a station left unused. Reported, never refused.

missing_required_file.description: A file the specification requires is missing from the archive, such as agency.txt, routes.txt, trips.txt or stop_times.txt. When every required file is reported, the folder was probably zipped in place of its files.

missing_recommended_file.description: A file the specification recommends is missing from the archive, such as feed_info.txt.

missing_required_column.description: A column the specification requires is missing from the header of a file.

missing_required_field.description: A required field is empty in a row where the specification asks for a value, such as stop_id, trip_id or route_id.

csv_parsing_failed.description: A file could not be read as CSV. A frequent cause is a cell of more than 4 096 characters.

empty_file.description: A file of the archive is empty: it has no header line, or it is a required file without any row of data.

empty_column_name.description: The header of a file holds a column without a name. The validator skips such a column.

duplicated_column.description: The header of a file names the same column twice.

invalid_row_length.description: A row of a file does not have as many values as the header has columns.

new_line_in_value.description: A value holds a line break. It usually comes from a double quote that is never closed, which makes the next line part of the value.

duplicate_key.description: Two rows of a file have the same primary key, for example the same stop_id in stops.txt, or the same trip_id and stop_sequence in stop_times.txt.

foreign_key_violation.description: A value refers to a record that its parent file does not hold, for example a route_id of trips.txt absent from routes.txt, or a service_id of trips.txt found neither in calendar.txt nor in calendar_dates.txt.

number_out_of_range.description: A number is outside the values its field allows, for example a latitude beyond -90 to 90, a longitude beyond -180 to 180, or a negative value where the field takes none.

invalid_url.description: A field holds a web address that is not well formed. The validator checks it with the Apache Commons UrlValidator.

invalid_color.description: A colour field is not six hexadecimal digits without the leading #, such as FFFFFF for white or 0039A6.

invalid_time.description: A time is not written as H:MM:SS, HH:MM:SS or HHH:MM:SS, such as 14:30:00, or 25:35:00 for 1:35 the next morning.

invalid_date.description: A date is not written as YYYYMMDD, such as 20180913 for 13 September 2018.

invalid_timezone.description: A time zone is not a name of the IANA database, such as Europe/Paris or America/Los_Angeles. A zone name holds no space.

invalid_language_code.description: A language field does not hold an IETF BCP 47 code, such as en, en-US or de.

start_and_end_range_out_of_order.description: A start is after its end: the start_date and end_date of calendar.txt, the feed_start_date and feed_end_date of feed_info.txt, the start_time and end_time of frequencies.txt or timeframes.txt, or the arrival_time and departure_time of a row of stop_times.txt.

more_than_one_entity.description: feed_info.txt has more than one row of data. The file describes the GTFS as a whole and holds a single row.

inconsistent_agency_timezone.description: The agencies of agency.txt declare different values of agency_timezone. Every agency of a GTFS must be in the same time zone.

inconsistent_agency_lang.description: The agencies of agency.txt declare different values of agency_lang.

stop_without_location.description: A stop or platform (location_type=0), a station (1) or an entrance (2) of stops.txt lacks its stop_lat or its stop_lon.

station_with_parent_station.description: A station (location_type=1) of stops.txt has a parent_station. A station is the top of its hierarchy.

location_without_parent_station.description: An entrance (location_type=2), a generic node (3) or a boarding area (4) of stops.txt has no parent_station.

wrong_parent_location_type.description: The parent_station of a location of stops.txt is not of the type its child takes: a stop, an entrance or a generic node has a station for parent, a boarding area has a platform.

missing_stop_name.description: A stop or platform (location_type=0), a station (1) or an entrance (2) of stops.txt has no stop_name.

same_name_and_description_for_stop.description: The stop_desc of a stop in stops.txt repeats its stop_name. A description adds information to the name.

route_both_short_and_long_name_missing.description: A route of routes.txt has neither a route_short_name nor a route_long_name. At least one of the two is required.

route_short_name_too_long.description: The route_short_name of a route in routes.txt has more than 12 characters.

route_color_contrast.description: The route_color and the route_text_color of a route in routes.txt are too close in brightness: their luma (Rec. 601) differs by less than 72 out of 255, so the text hardly reads on its background.

route_long_name_contains_short_name.description: The route_long_name of a route in routes.txt starts with its route_short_name followed by a space, a hyphen or a parenthesis, or repeats it exactly. Apps show the two names together, so the long name should not hold the short one.

same_name_and_description_for_route.description: The route_desc of a route in routes.txt repeats its route_short_name or its route_long_name. A description adds information to the name.

duplicate_route_name.description: Two routes of routes.txt have the same route_short_name, the same route_long_name, the same route_type and the same agency_id. The two directions of a line are one route; two distinct routes should differ by a name.

expired_calendar.description: The last active date of a service, read from calendar.txt with the exceptions of calendar_dates.txt, is in the past. In a GTFS dated by calendar_dates.txt alone, the services are reported only when every one of them has ended.

missing_calendar_and_calendar_date_files.description: Both calendar.txt and calendar_dates.txt are missing. At least one of them must date the services.

stop_time_with_only_arrival_or_departure.description: A row of stop_times.txt gives only one of arrival_time and departure_time. A stop time gives both, or neither.

stop_time_timepoint_without_times.description: A row of stop_times.txt with timepoint=1 lacks its arrival_time or its departure_time. A time declared exact gives both.

missing_trip_edge.description: The first or the last stop of a trip has no arrival_time or no departure_time in stop_times.txt. Both ends of a trip give both times, the same value twice when the vehicle does not wait.

forbidden_pickup_type.description: A row of stop_times.txt gives a pickup or drop-off window with pickup_type=0 (regular pickup) or 3 (to arrange with the driver). The window fields are forbidden with these two values.

forbidden_drop_off_type.description: A row of stop_times.txt gives a pickup or drop-off window with drop_off_type=0 (regular drop-off). The window fields are forbidden with a regular drop-off.

forbidden_continuous_pickup_drop_off.description: A route of routes.txt declares continuous_pickup or continuous_drop_off at 0, 2 or 3 while a row of stop_times.txt of one of its trips gives a start_pickup_drop_off_window or an end_pickup_drop_off_window. Continuous pickup or drop-off cannot be combined with a window.

stop_without_stop_time.description: A stop of stops.txt (location_type=0) is named by no stop_id of stop_times.txt, nor by a location group a trip calls at: no trip serves it.

unused_trip.description: A trip of trips.txt has no row in stop_times.txt.

block_trips_with_overlapping_stop_times.description: Two trips of trips.txt with the same block_id run at overlapping times in stop_times.txt on at least one date their services share: one vehicle cannot run both.

decreasing_shape_distance.description: In shapes.txt, shape_dist_traveled decreases between two consecutive points of a shape, read in the order of shape_pt_sequence.

equal_shape_distance_diff_coordinates.description: In shapes.txt, two consecutive points of a shape have the same shape_dist_traveled while they stand 1.11 m or more apart. The distance must increase along the shape.

equal_shape_distance_same_coordinates.description: In shapes.txt, two consecutive points of a shape have the same shape_dist_traveled and the same coordinates: the point is written twice.

single_shape_point.description: A shape of shapes.txt has a single point. A shape takes two points at least to draw a path.

unused_shape.description: A shape of shapes.txt is used by no trip of trips.txt.

overlapping_frequency.description: Two rows of frequencies.txt for the same trip_id cover overlapping periods: the second starts before the first ends.

transfer_distance_too_large.description: A row of transfers.txt links two stops more than 10 km apart.

missing_feed_info_date.description: feed_info.txt gives only one of feed_start_date and feed_end_date. Both are optional, but one should not go without the other.

feed_info_lang_and_agency_lang_mismatch.description: The agency_lang of an agency in agency.txt differs from the feed_lang of feed_info.txt. A GTFS whose texts are in several languages declares feed_lang=mul, which the validator accepts with any agency_lang.

bidirectional_exit_gate.description: A pathway of pathways.txt is an exit gate (pathway_mode=7) declared in both directions (is_bidirectional=1). An exit gate is crossed one way only.

pathway_to_wrong_location_type.description: A pathway of pathways.txt ends at a station (location_type=1). A pathway links platforms, entrances, generic nodes or boarding areas.

pathway_unreachable_location.description: In a station described by pathways.txt, a platform, a boarding area or a generic node cannot be reached from any entrance, or no exit can be reached from it. A platform that has boarding areas is not reported: its boarding areas are.

pathway_to_platform_with_boarding_areas.description: A pathway of pathways.txt ends at a platform that has boarding areas. Such a platform is a parent, not a point: its pathways go to its boarding areas.

pathway_dangling_generic_node.description: A generic node (location_type=3 in stops.txt) is linked by pathways.txt to a single other location. A node is a passage: reached from one place only, it leads nowhere.

pathway_loop.description: A pathway of pathways.txt has the same from_stop_id and to_stop_id: it starts and ends at the same location.

missing_level_id.description: A location of stops.txt at one end of an elevator pathway (pathway_mode=5 in pathways.txt) has no level_id. An elevator needs the level of each of its ends.

translation_foreign_key_violation.description: A row of translations.txt names by record_id, and record_sub_id where the table takes one, a record its table_name does not hold.

translation_unexpected_value.description: A row of translations.txt fills a field that must stay empty: a record_id or a record_sub_id beside a field_value, or a record_sub_id for a table whose records a single identifier names.

translation_unknown_table_name.description: A row of translations.txt names in table_name a table that is not a GTFS file or that the archive does not hold.

attribution_without_role.description: A row of attributions.txt sets none of is_producer, is_operator and is_authority to 1: the organisation is credited without a role.

point_near_origin.description: A stop of stops.txt, a point of shapes.txt or of locations.geojson lies within one degree of latitude and of longitude of the point (0, 0), in the Gulf of Guinea: its coordinates are probably missing or wrong.

duplicate_fare_media.description: Two rows of fare_media.txt have the same fare_media_name and the same fare_media_type: nothing tells the two fare media apart.

invalid_currency.description: A currency field does not hold an ISO 4217 code, such as EUR, CAD or JPY.

invalid_currency_amount.description: An amount does not have the number of decimal places its currency takes (ISO 4217): two for EUR, none for JPY.

fare_product_with_multiple_default_rider.description: A fare product of fare_products.txt is tied to more than one rider category marked as default (is_default_fare_category=1 in rider_categories.txt). A product has one default category at most.

fare_transfer_rule_duration_limit_type_w.description: A row of fare_transfer_rules.txt gives a duration_limit_type and no duration_limit.

fare_transfer_rule_duration_limit_withou.description: A row of fare_transfer_rules.txt gives a duration_limit and no duration_limit_type.

fare_transfer_rule_invalid_transfer_coun.description: A row of fare_transfer_rules.txt whose from_leg_group_id equals its to_leg_group_id has a transfer_count that is neither -1 (no limit) nor 1 or more.

fare_transfer_rule_missing_transfer_coun.description: Former name of fare_transfer_rule_without_transfer_count. The validator renamed it in version 8.0 and no longer raises it under this code.

fare_transfer_rule_with_forbidden_transf.description: A row of fare_transfer_rules.txt gives a transfer_count while its from_leg_group_id differs from its to_leg_group_id. The count is allowed only when the two are the same.

forbidden_real_time_booking_field_value.description: A row of booking_rules.txt with booking_type=0 (real-time booking) fills a field of advance notice: prior_notice_duration_min, prior_notice_duration_max, prior_notice_last_day, prior_notice_last_time, prior_notice_start_day, prior_notice_start_time or prior_notice_service_id.

forbidden_prior_day_booking_field_value.description: A row of booking_rules.txt with booking_type=2 (booking up to a prior day) fills prior_notice_duration_min or prior_notice_duration_max, which belong to same-day booking.

missing_prior_notice_duration_min.description: A row of booking_rules.txt with booking_type=1 (same-day booking) has no prior_notice_duration_min.

malformed_json.description: locations.geojson cannot be read as JSON: the file is not well formed.

unsupported_geo_json_type.description: The root of locations.geojson has a type other than FeatureCollection.

unsupported_feature_type.description: An object of the features of locations.geojson has a type other than Feature.

unsupported_geometry_type.description: A feature of locations.geojson has a geometry that is neither a Polygon nor a MultiPolygon, the two types GTFS supports.

invalid_geometry.description: A polygon of locations.geojson cannot be read or is not valid, as the OpenGIS Simple Features specification defines a valid polygon.

duplicate_geo_json_key.description: Two features of locations.geojson have the same id. Each feature has an id of its own.

duplicate_geography_id.description: The same identifier is used in more than one of stops.txt (stop_id), location_groups.txt (location_group_id) and locations.geojson (id). These identifiers must be unique across the three files.

geo_json_duplicated_element.description: An element of locations.geojson, such as type or features, is written more than once in the same object.

geo_json_unknown_element.description: locations.geojson holds an element the GTFS specification does not define there.

unknown_file.description: The archive holds a file the GTFS specification does not define. Tools that follow the specification ignore the file.

unknown_column.description: A file has a column the GTFS specification does not define for it. Tools that follow the specification ignore the column.

leading_or_trailing_whitespaces.description: A value written between double quotes starts or ends with a space. The validator reads the value without it, but an identifier written with the space in one file and without it in another may not match for other tools.

invalid_phone_number.description: A phone number is not well formed for the country of the GTFS. The validator checks it only when it is given a country code.

forbidden_same_day_booking_field_value.description: A row of booking_rules.txt with booking_type=1 (same-day booking) fills prior_notice_last_day, prior_notice_last_time or prior_notice_service_id, which belong to booking on a prior day.

missing_prior_day_booking_field_value.description: Former notice for a prior-day booking rule without its last day or its last time. Since version 7.0.0 the validator raises missing_prior_notice_last_day and missing_prior_notice_last_time in its place.

missing_prior_notice_last_day.description: A row of booking_rules.txt with booking_type=2 (booking up to a prior day) has no prior_notice_last_day.

missing_prior_notice_last_time.description: A row of booking_rules.txt with booking_type=2 (booking up to a prior day) has no prior_notice_last_time.

missing_prior_notice_start_time.description: A row of booking_rules.txt fills prior_notice_start_day without prior_notice_start_time.

forbidden_prior_notice_start_day.description: A row of booking_rules.txt fills prior_notice_start_day together with prior_notice_duration_max. The two cannot be combined.

forbidden_prior_notice_start_time.description: A row of booking_rules.txt fills prior_notice_start_time without prior_notice_start_day.

invalid_prior_notice_duration_min.description: In a row of booking_rules.txt, prior_notice_duration_max is lower than prior_notice_duration_min.

prior_notice_last_day_after_start_day.description: In a row of booking_rules.txt, prior_notice_last_day is greater than prior_notice_start_day: booking would close before it opens.

missing_pickup_drop_off_booking_rule_id.description: A row of stop_times.txt with a pickup or drop-off window asks riders to phone the agency (pickup_type=2 or drop_off_type=2) without the matching pickup_booking_rule_id or drop_off_booking_rule_id, while the GTFS has a booking_rules.txt.

forbidden_arrival_or_departure_time.description: A row of stop_times.txt gives an arrival_time or a departure_time together with a start_pickup_drop_off_window or an end_pickup_drop_off_window. A stop time has either times or a window.

missing_pickup_or_drop_off_window.description: A row of stop_times.txt gives only one of start_pickup_drop_off_window and end_pickup_drop_off_window. A window has both its start and its end.

invalid_pickup_drop_off_window.description: In a row of stop_times.txt, end_pickup_drop_off_window is not after start_pickup_drop_off_window.

overlapping_zone_and_pickup_drop_off_win.description: Two rows of stop_times.txt of one trip, with the same pickup_type or drop_off_type, have pickup and drop-off windows that overlap in time and zones of locations.geojson that overlap on the map.

timeframe_overlap.description: Two rows of timeframes.txt with the same timeframe_group_id and service_id cover overlapping periods: the second starts before the first ends.

timeframe_only_start_or_end_time_specifi.description: A row of timeframes.txt gives only one of start_time and end_time. A timeframe gives both, or neither.

timeframe_start_or_end_time_greater_than.description: A start_time or an end_time of timeframes.txt is later than 24:00:00. A timeframe stays within one day.

unusable_trip.description: A trip of trips.txt has fewer than two rows in stop_times.txt. Riders can board and alight only on a trip that calls at two stops at least.

unused_station.description: A station (location_type=1) of stops.txt is the parent_station of no stop.

fast_travel_between_consecutive_stops.description: Between two consecutive stops of a trip, the distance between the stops of stops.txt and the times of stop_times.txt give a speed above what the route_type of routes.txt allows: 100 km/h for a tram, 150 for a metro, a bus, a trolleybus or a monorail, 500 for a train, 80 for a ferry, 30 for a cable tram, 50 for an aerial lift or a funicular, 200 for any other type. Times written to the minute are given one more minute.

fast_travel_between_far_stops.description: Between two stops of a trip more than 10 km apart, the distance and the times of stop_times.txt give a speed above what the route_type allows, with the limits of fast_travel_between_consecutive_stops. It usually points to a more serious error than a fast leg between two neighbouring stops.

mixed_case_recommended_field.description: A name shown to riders, such as stop_name, route_long_name or trip_headsign, has two words or more of more than a letter and none of them mixes capitals and small letters (GARE ROUTIERE, gare routière), or is a single word all in lower case. A single word in capitals is not reported: it may be an acronym. Mixed case reads better on a screen and for a screen reader.

non_ascii_or_non_printable_char.description: An identifier (a field of type ID, such as stop_id or trip_id) holds a character outside printable ASCII, for example an accented letter or a tab. Such identifiers are allowed but not recommended.

empty_row.description: A row of a file holds only spaces. Some CSV readers take it for a row with a single empty value.

start_and_end_range_equal.description: A row of frequencies.txt or of timeframes.txt has the same start_time and end_time: the period lasts no time.

missing_recommended_field.description: A field the specification recommends is empty in a row, for example the agency_id of a route in routes.txt when the GTFS has a single agency.

missing_feed_contact_email_and_url.description: feed_info.txt gives neither feed_contact_email nor feed_contact_url: nobody can report a problem with the data to its publisher.

unused_parent_station.description: Former name of unused_station. The validator renamed it in version 7.0.0 and no longer raises it under this code.

platform_without_parent_station.description: A stop of stops.txt that has a platform_code has no parent_station. A platform is expected to belong to a station.

stop_without_zone_id.description: A stop of stops.txt has no zone_id while it is served by a route whose fares in fare_rules.txt depend on zones (origin_id, destination_id or contains_id).

missing_bike_allowance.description: A trip of a ferry route (route_type=4 in routes.txt) does not say in trips.txt whether bikes are allowed: its bikes_allowed is empty or 0.

same_route_and_agency_url.description: The route_url of a route in routes.txt is the agency_url of an agency in agency.txt. A route's address leads to the page of that route.

same_stop_and_agency_url.description: The stop_url of a stop in stops.txt is the agency_url of an agency in agency.txt. A stop's address leads to the page of that stop.

same_stop_and_route_url.description: The stop_url of a stop in stops.txt is the route_url of a route in routes.txt. A stop's address leads to the page of that stop.

route_networks_specified_in_more_than_on.description: routes.txt has a network_id column while the GTFS also has a route_networks.txt or a networks.txt. The network of a route is given in one place only.

transfer_distance_above_2_km.description: A row of transfers.txt links two stops more than 2 km apart, and 10 km at most (beyond, the validator raises transfer_distance_too_large).

transfer_with_invalid_stop_location_type.description: A from_stop_id or a to_stop_id of transfers.txt names a location that is neither a stop or platform (location_type=0) nor a station (1).

transfer_with_invalid_trip_and_route.description: A row of transfers.txt names a trip and a route that do not go together: the from_trip_id or the to_trip_id belongs in trips.txt to another route than the from_route_id or the to_route_id beside it.

transfer_with_suspicious_mid_trip_in_sea.description: A row of transfers.txt where riders stay on board (transfer_type=4 or 5) names a stop in the middle of a trip. The from_stop_id is expected to be the last stop of the from_trip_id, and the to_stop_id the first stop of the to_trip_id.

stop_time_with_arrival_before_previous_d.description: In stop_times.txt, a trip reaches a stop at an arrival_time earlier than the departure_time of its previous stop: the vehicle would travel back in time.

decreasing_or_equal_stop_time_distance.description: In stop_times.txt, shape_dist_traveled does not increase between two consecutive stops of a trip, read in the order of stop_sequence: the second value is lower than or equal to the first.

forbidden_shape_dist_traveled.description: A row of stop_times.txt that names a location_group_id or a location_id, and no stop_id, gives a shape_dist_traveled. The distance along the shape is meant for stops only.

point_near_pole.description: A stop of stops.txt, a point of shapes.txt or of locations.geojson has a latitude of 89 degrees or more, north or south: its coordinates are probably wrong.

stop_too_far_from_shape.description: A stop of a trip stands more than 100 m from the shape of the trip in shapes.txt (400 m for a stop of a rail route). The stop is misplaced in stops.txt, or the shape does not follow the trip.

stop_too_far_from_shape_using_user_dista.description: A stop of a trip stands far from the point of its shape that its shape_dist_traveled in stop_times.txt names. The distance written, the position of the stop or the shape is wrong.

stops_match_shape_out_of_order.description: Two stops of a trip match its shape of shapes.txt in the reverse of their order in stop_times.txt. The position of a stop, the shape or the order of the stops is wrong.

trip_distance_exceeds_shape_distance.description: The last stop of a trip has in stop_times.txt a shape_dist_traveled greater than the largest of its shape in shapes.txt, and stands more than 11.1 m from the last point of the shape: the trip runs beyond its shape.

trip_distance_exceeds_shape_distance_bel.description: The last stop of a trip has in stop_times.txt a shape_dist_traveled greater than the largest of its shape in shapes.txt, but stands within 11.1 m of the last point of the shape.

stop_has_too_many_matches_for_shape.description: A stop of a trip could match its shape of shapes.txt at more than 20 places: the shape passes near the stop again and again, or the stop is misplaced in stops.txt.

equal_shape_distance_diff_coordinates_di.description: In shapes.txt, two consecutive points of a shape have the same shape_dist_traveled and different coordinates less than 1.11 m apart.

location_with_unexpected_stop_time.description: A row of stop_times.txt names by its stop_id a location of stops.txt that is not a stop or platform: its location_type is not 0 or empty. Trips call at stops, not at stations, entrances or nodes.

missing_timepoint_value.description: A row of stop_times.txt gives an arrival_time or a departure_time and leaves timepoint empty, in a file that has the timepoint column. The field says whether the times are exact (1) or approximate (0).

missing_stop_times_record.description: A trip has a single row in stop_times.txt for an on-demand service within a location group or a zone: a pickup and drop-off window, with pickup_type=2 and drop_off_type=2. Travel inside one such place takes two rows with the same location_group_id or location_id.

trip_coverage_not_active_for_next7_days.description: The period in which most of the trips run does not cover the next seven days: it starts after today or ends within a week, as calendar.txt, calendar_dates.txt and frequencies.txt count the trips of trips.txt on each date.

transfer_with_invalid_trip_and_stop.description: A row of transfers.txt names a trip and a stop that do not go together: the from_stop_id or the to_stop_id is not among the stops of the from_trip_id or the to_trip_id in stop_times.txt.

forbidden_geography_id.description: A row of stop_times.txt fills more than one of stop_id, location_group_id and location_id. A stop time names one place only.

big_gap_in_service.description: A service of calendar.txt runs on no day for more than 13 days in a row between two of its active dates, the exceptions of calendar_dates.txt counted. The notice gives the first and the last day of the gap.

fare_transfer_rule_without_transfer_coun.description: A row of fare_transfer_rules.txt has the same from_leg_group_id and to_leg_group_id and no transfer_count. The count is required when the two are the same.

feed_expiration_date30_days.description: The feed_end_date of feed_info.txt is less than 30 days away, and 7 days or more (under 7 days the validator raises feed_expiration_date7_days). A published GTFS should cover at least the next 30 days of service.

feed_expiration_date7_days.description: The feed_end_date of feed_info.txt is less than 7 days away, or already past. A published GTFS should stay valid for at least the next 7 days.

feed_valid_beyond_total_service_window.description: The validity declared in feed_info.txt starts more than 14 days before the first day of service of the trips, or ends more than 14 days after their last day, as calendar.txt and calendar_dates.txt date them.

future_calendar.description: Every service the trips use starts after today, as calendar.txt and calendar_dates.txt date them: no service covers today's date.

future_feed.description: The feed_start_date of feed_info.txt is after today: the GTFS covers the future only.

i_o_error.description: The validator met an input or output error while it read the GTFS. It is a failure of the validation, not a defect of the data.

inconsistent_route_type_for_block_id.description: The trips of trips.txt sharing a block_id belong to routes of different route_type in routes.txt. One vehicle runs a block, so its trips should be of one mode.

inconsistent_route_type_for_in_seat_tran.description: A row of transfers.txt with transfer_type=4 (the rider stays on board) links a from_route_id and a to_route_id of different route_type in routes.txt. Such a transfer should stay within one mode.

invalid_character.description: A value holds a character that is no text, such as the replacement character U+FFFD: the file was probably not saved in UTF-8, the encoding GTFS requires.

invalid_email.description: A field holds an e-mail address that is not well formed. The validator checks it with the Apache Commons EmailValidator.

invalid_float.description: A field that takes a decimal number holds a value that cannot be read as one.

invalid_input_files_in_subfolder.description: At least one GTFS file sits in a subfolder of the archive. The files must be at its root: zip the files themselves, not the folder that holds them.

invalid_integer.description: A field that takes a whole number holds a value that cannot be read as one.

missing_recommended_column.description: A recommended column is missing from a file. The validator has kept this notice in its list since version 7.0.0 without raising it any more.

missing_required_agency_id.description: The GTFS has more than one agency and an agency_id is empty in agency.txt, routes.txt or fare_attributes.txt. The identifier is required as soon as there are several agencies.

missing_required_element.description: locations.geojson lacks an element the specification requires, such as the type of the collection, the id of a feature or its geometry.

pathway_to_stop_with_access_outside_of_s.description: A pathway of pathways.txt ends at a stop declared with stop_access=1 in stops.txt, that is, reached from the street without the pathways of its station. Such a stop takes no pathway.

runtime_exception_in_loader_error.description: The validator failed while it loaded a file into memory. It usually is a defect of the validator itself, not of the GTFS.

runtime_exception_in_validator_error.description: One of the validator's checks failed while it ran, so its findings are missing from the report. It usually is a defect of the validator itself, not of the GTFS.

service_extends_far_in_the_future.description: A service of calendar.txt runs until a date more than two years (730 days) after today, the exceptions of calendar_dates.txt counted.

service_has_no_active_day_of_the_week.description: A service of calendar.txt has its seven days of the week at 0. It can run only on the dates calendar_dates.txt adds to it.

service_window_outside_feed_period.description: A service the trips use runs before the feed_start_date or after the feed_end_date of feed_info.txt, as calendar.txt and calendar_dates.txt date it. The notice gives the number of days outside the validity.

stop_access_specified_for_incorrect_loca.description: A station, an entrance, a generic node or a boarding area of stops.txt fills stop_access. The field is for a stop or platform (location_type=0) that belongs to a station.

stop_access_specified_for_stop_with_no_p.description: A stop of stops.txt fills stop_access and has no parent_station. The field says how a stop is reached within its station, so it needs one.

thread_execution_error.description: A check the validator ran in parallel failed, so its findings are missing from the report. It is a failure of the validation, not a defect of the GTFS.

too_many_rows.description: A file has more than 1 000 000 000 rows. A file that large cannot be processed in a reasonable time by the tools that read a GTFS.

trip_headsign_matches_intermediate_stop.description: The trip_headsign of a trip in trips.txt is the stop_name of a stop the trip calls at before its last. Riders boarding after that stop read a destination the vehicle has already passed.

trip_with_shape_dist_traveled_but_no_sha.description: A trip gives shape_dist_traveled values in stop_times.txt while its shape in shapes.txt does not give one on every point: the distances of the stops cannot be placed along the shape.

u_r_i_syntax_error.description: The validator could not read as a URI an address it was given. It concerns the way the validation was launched, not the GTFS.

unexpected_enum_value.description: A field that takes one of a list of values holds a number outside the list the validator knows, for example an extended route_type such as 700 in routes.txt. The value may be valid for the tools that read it.

unsorted_stop_times.description: The rows of a trip in stop_times.txt are not in the order of stop_sequence, or do not follow one another in the file.
